csv_scope_of_work: The State of Florida, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a consultant to provide design Build services for the I-4 (S.R. 400) corridor from West of Osceola Parkway to just East of World Center Drive (S.R. 536). The scope includes mainline reconstruction/widening to add two express lanes in each direction. The scope also includes milling and resurfacing, modifications and tie-ins to interchange ramps, bridge replacements for the I-4 bridges over the Bonnet Creek Canal, drainage system construction, signing and pavement markings, lighting and ITS upgrades. In addition to this work, a buffer-separated single eastbound express lane will be constructed for approximately 9 miles, extending east to tie into the existing eastbound express lanes just to the west of the Universal Blvd Interchange.
